comments.author: Scrimshaw
comments.body: Just to confirm for anyone wondering, this is repeatable even if you have the discovery card (probably should at least have it reported as I did). And a very easy easy one to do if trying to deliver a Great ruler's orb to Beirut for Solar Barge construction. Just make sure to accept the Secret Edict quest before you leave so you can deliver the orb as soon as you get it.
